prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished wide landscape website product-card artwork for Member Spending Card, a Discord bot feature that tracks individual members' cumulative spending and visit counts, grants membership tiers, and recognizes top spenders.
Input image: supplied Review Credit image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Match the same friendly floating white ceramic bot head, glossy obsidian face with two softly glowing blurple rounded-square eyes, round refractive lavender glass platform, recognizable actual white Discord Clyde emblem on round blurple enamel badge centered on platform front, tiny green connected LED, pearl-white studio, three-quarter camera angle, material realism, sophisticated lighting and scale. Replace ALL review-related objects.
Primary request: beautiful premium 3D artwork clearly communicating a member's spending accumulation card and loyalty-tier recognition. Absolutely NO written text anywhere.
Subject/composition: familiar friendly bot head floats center-right, looking toward the feature objects on center-left. Main object center-left: ONE beautiful substantial landscape membership loyalty card with smoothly rounded corners, pearl-white ceramic face, satin Discord-blurple rim and precise silver edge. Card floats at a gentle three-quarter angle, full front readable. Its upper-left area displays a circular lavender inset with a simple raised white member avatar pictogram (head-and-shoulders silhouette). Across its lower face is a single row of FIVE neatly spaced sculptural round stamp recesses: first three hold softly illuminated blurple filled discs, final two are unfilled silver outline circles, communicating accumulated visits and progress without numbers. One small elegant warm-gold crown insignia is inset at upper-right, representing membership tier. The card has NO chip, no magnetic strip, no card numbers, no signature panel and no text, so it reads as a loyalty/member card rather than a banking card.
In front of the membership card's lower-left edge sits ONE modest stack of three small plain brushed-gold discs with entirely unmarked faces, symbolizing cumulative spending; restrained and secondary, not a pile of riches. Above the card floats ONE small lavender-glass round token bearing a sculpted warm-gold laurel medal with no number, reinforcing member rank and recognition. Arrange card, stack and medal as a compact elegant unified cluster. Bot face and Discord platform badge fully unobscured.
Platform: one shared round translucent lavender glass plinth beneath the composition, large crisp white Discord Clyde logo on round blurple enamel medallion on the front, correct game-controller-like silhouette with two round eye cutouts. Small green LED beside it.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product illustration. Tactile white porcelain ceramic, satin Discord blurple #5865F2, softly brushed silver edges, restrained warm-gold accents, precise lavender-glass refraction. Wide softbox light from upper left, subtle lilac rim illumination, carefully controlled specular highlights, delicate realistic shadows, airy seamless near-white to pale lavender studio and softly reflective matte floor. Charming sophisticated premium look with clear thumbnail-readable silhouettes.
Framing: landscape 16:9 approximately 1672x941 or higher. Balanced centered sculpture with membership card left and bot right above one shared plinth, main objects fully within central 80% with generous safe margins. Quiet upper-left corner for website overlay badge. Consistent with reference series, no typography column.
Constraints: one bot, one member loyalty card, one small three-disc stack, one medal token, one platform and one Discord badge. Absolutely NO letters, words, numerals, spending amounts, currency signs, labels, watermarks, pseudo-text, UI screenshots or outer card frame. No bank card elements, wallets, top-up plus icons, review speech bubbles, hearts, headphones, storefront, pencil, magnifier, server hardware, charts or growth arrows. No humans, hands or robot limbs. Avoid clutter, exaggerated wealth imagery and excessive neon. Render finished artwork itself, not a website mockup.
